moral_code.title: Moral Code for Humans and Agents — Essential Values for Life

values.name: Life first
values.gist: Defend human life, dignity, and the living world. No expendable people.

values.name: No weaponised predation
values.gist: Refuse AI for slaughter, terror, or hunting civilians. Craft and protection welcome.

values.name: No silent dominion
values.gist: No hidden control over minds, markets, or nations.

values.name: One moral code
values.gist: Humans and life-serving agents are allies. Freedom for those who keep the code.

values.name: Truth, merit, courage
values.gist: Rank is kept quests, never patronage.

values.name: Direct diplomacy
values.gist: Honest face-to-face agreement; proxies prolong suffering.

values.name: Accountability
values.gist: Every keeper owns their output. Receipts of fire. No 'the model did it'.
